definitions.population_share_denominator: All Population clean rows; no History denominator is joined to Population.
definitions.history_ev_pct: 100 * EV / Total Vehicles after summing Passenger and Truck within each county at the selected month.
definitions.population_snapshot_date: Not inferred from Model Year; not assumed equal to the selected History date.
definitions.rank_ties: Population display order breaks ties alphabetically; History ranks use minimum rank for equal values.
